title: Work Done by Pushing a Box
question: A person pushes a box with a force of 10 N over a distance of 5 meters. What is the work done?

title: Work Done by Pulling a Cart
question: A cart is pulled with a force of 25 N for 3 meters in the same direction. Compute the work.

title: Work Done by Lifting a Box
question: A woman lifts a box vertically upward with a force of 60 N to a height of 2 meters. Compute the work.
